battery_sampling_revision_20261023.tests: 25 host regression groups passed; real sampler/filter source exercised for cache reads/rate/settling/trim/median/failures/retry/guards/wake/wrap/slow drift/endpoints; 73 C units static analysis, 11 pre-existing diagnostics; build 0 errors, 2 original warnings
battery_sampling_revision_20261023.limits: AT idle is only a software proxy for a quieter load, not RF idle detection. First report may still be initial 100 if no safe sample window exists. 60s is a minimum update interval, not a forced wake schedule. Elapsed EMA approximates past minutes with newest sample; battery curve/ADC calibration need board measurements. No guarantee of identical readings on every reset.
